integrity_requirements: Law of Law: no unresolved contradictions within the skill's scope
Epistemic class: all claims labeled SOURCE / DERIVED / AMOS_MODEL / EMPIRICAL
Provenance: source path recorded for every formatting change
Reversibility: all formatting changes are reversible via git
safety_constraints: No claim beyond established evidence or explicitly labeled AMOS_MODEL
Fail closed on UNKNOWN/GAP: do not fabricate to remove placeholders
Never delete content during formatting — only restructure whitespace and syntax
Preserve all wikilink targets and frontmatter fields during normalization
composition_rules: Can be invoked by amos-knowledge-research-master for vault maintenance
Can be composed with amos-c11-design-language-master for content style
Cannot override epistemic class labels during formatting

evaluation.self_check: verify all formatted files parse as valid Markdown
evaluation.external_check: diff against original to confirm only formatting changes
evaluation.gate_check: all wikilinks resolve, all frontmatter parses
